key_semantics.day: YYYYMMDD device-local calendar day at capture start
key_semantics.segment_len: real captured whole-second media duration; stamped at capture finish; bounded by the segment rotation ceiling (300 seconds standard); crash-recovered LEN <= real media duration; descriptive only, not grammar-enforced -- an implementation that enforces a ceiling refuses exactly the crash-recovered uploads the looseness exists to permit
key_semantics.on_disk_segment_key: after a content collision the directory name carries an incremented duration field and is an allocation artifact; requested_segment in the segment manifest is the device truth. No reader may infer capture duration from a directory name
key_semantics.source: a device-chosen sub-stream discriminator, empty for the primary capture. It is not identity and authenticates nothing -- it selects within an already-authenticated device own namespace

x-journal-contract.write_discipline: multipart envelope validated before segment write
